item.title: Introduction to Hugging Face: From API to Fine-Tuning
item.description: This guide provides a practical introduction to the Hugging Face ecosystem. You’ll learn how to find and use models via the API, work with key components like Transformers and Tokenizers, and grasp the fundamentals of fine-tuning. Finally, we cover designing, training, and evaluating custom models for downstream tasks.
